_comment: TRAIL band, calibrated specifically for UGLD (ЮГК). One phase of 12 evaluations, not the root file's 60, because most of the root axis cannot bind here. The trail only becomes the binding stop once maxFav - Trail*dailyATR rises above entry - Stop*dailyATR, i.e. once price has advanced (Trail - Stop) daily ATR above entry — and UGLD inherits core.DefaultParams(), where StopDailyATR=0.5 and TPDailyATR is only 0.6. A trail of 1.0 would need +0.5 ATR before arming, by which point the 0.6 target is about to close the trade anyway; the root grid's 1.2 and 1.5 rows are simply unreachable on this baseline. Hence 0.2..0.6. IMPORTANT: this file is only honest AFTER ugld/cal_risk.json has been run and its winning stop/target pair pinned into the ticker package or passed via -params — swept over the shipped 0.5/0.6 baseline it measures a trail squeezed into a 0.1-ATR window. Read the halves differently: 0.2-0.4 is not really trailing, it TIGHTENS the initial stop (maxFav starts at the entry price, so the level sits at entry - Trail*dailyATR from the very first bar, closer than the fixed 0.5 stop before price has moved at all) — a win there is a stop recalibration wearing trail parameters and belongs in cal_risk.json; 0.5 is the neutral point matching the fixed stop at entry; 0.6 is the only genuinely late trail this baseline allows. TrailDailyATR=0 with UseTrail=1 is the control row, not a mistake: desiredStop guards the trail with `TrailDailyATR > 0`, so that row IS the fixed-stop configuration, giving the phase its own baseline without the duplicate combos a UseTrail:[0,1] axis would generate. UseRSIExit is swept alongside because the RSI exit is what usually denies the trail its chance to fire — on UGLD, RSI(4) crosses 70 upward 818 times in 12 months, so it is a fast competitor — and one phase keeps all 12 rows in the final ranking instead of hiding the trail comparison in a discarded earlier phase. Watch the TRAIL share of exits, not just the profit factor: a set where the trail never fires is really just the old fixed-stop configuration wearing new parameters. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker UGLD -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/ugld/cal_trail.json -out ./reports/UGLD_trail -months 24 -min-trades 30 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor.
